http/internal/http2_input#

The single reader of an HTTP/2 connection: it reads every frame, answers PING and SETTINGS, and hands the rest to the session as events.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The single reader of an HTTP/2 connection: it reads every frame, answers PING and SETTINGS, and hands the rest to the session as events.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
